A.name: Contract A: Demo 1 synthetic GC/CM contract (School Modernization and Addition)

markup_own_pct.quote: A subcontractor may add overhead and profit of up to 10% on its own direct cost and up to 5% on the cost of work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_lower_pct.quote: A subcontractor may add overhead and profit of up to 10% on its own direct cost and up to 5% on the cost of work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_total_pct.quote: Total markup on any portion of the work shall not exceed 15%.

fee_pct.quote: CM may add a Fee of 5% to the direct costs and subcontractor markups of a change.

fee_allowed_on.quote: CM may add a Fee of 5% to the direct costs and subcontractor markups of a change.

labor_burden_pct.quote: plus a fixed labor burden of 32% of direct wages

blue_book_pct.quote: Other CM-owned equipment is charged at 75% of the current published Blue Book rental rate

approval_limit.quote: Owner's Representative may approve a CO of up to $250,000.

contract_days.quote: CM shall achieve Substantial Completion within 540 days after the Notice to Proceed

liquidated_damages_per_day.quote: CM shall pay Owner $2,500 for each day of delay.

daily_delay_rate.quote: SGC may be increased only by CO for an extension of Contract Time, at a daily rate of $3,185 per day.

sgc_total.quote: SGC is $1,720,000, billed as shown in Exhibit C.

extension_requires_critical_path.quote: An extension is available only for delays outside CM's control that are shown on the critical path

compensable_causes.quote: A time extension is compensated only for delays caused by Owner or Architect that are on the critical path, using the SGC daily rate in Section 5.2 and with no Fee.

concurrent_delay.quote: Delays with concurrent causes receive time but no compensation.

B.name: Contract B: synthetic GC/CM contract (Middle School Replacement)

markup_own_pct.quote: A Subcontractor may add a combined allowance for overhead and profit of not more than 8% of the cost of the changed work it performs with its own forces, and not more than 4% of the cost of changed work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_lower_pct.quote: A Subcontractor may add a combined allowance for overhead and profit of not more than 8% of the cost of the changed work it performs with its own forces, and not more than 4% of the cost of changed work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors.

markup_total_pct.quote: In no event shall the cumulative markup of all tiers on any portion of the changed work exceed 12%.

fee_pct.quote: On each Change Order CM may add a Fee of 4.5%, computed only on CM direct costs and subcontractor quotes.

fee_allowed_on.quote: On each Change Order CM may add a Fee of 4.5%, computed only on CM direct costs and subcontractor quotes.

labor_burden_pct.quote: plus a fixed labor burden equal to 30% of direct wages

blue_book_pct.quote: Equipment owned by CM or by an entity affiliated with CM shall be charged at 70% of the monthly, weekly, or daily rental rate

approval_limit.quote: The Owner's Representative may execute any Change Order whose value does not exceed $150,000.

notice_days_by_cause.quote: CM shall give written notice of a Potential Change within 10 days after it receives an RFI response, Architect's Supplemental Instruction, submittal return, or written or oral direction from Owner or Architect, or after it first observes a concealed or unknown physical condition, which in that case it shall not disturb before giving notice. For any other event that may increase its cost or time, CM shall give notice within 21 days after it knew or reasonably should have known of the event.

contract_days.quote: CM shall achieve Substantial Completion of the entire Work not later than 420 days after the date of commencement

liquidated_damages_per_day.quote: $1,800 for each day that Substantial Completion is late

daily_delay_rate.quote: the General Conditions Costs shall be increased at the rate of $2,450 for each day of the extension, with no Fee added

sgc_total.quote: The General Conditions Costs are a fixed sum of $1,286,000

extension_requires_critical_path.quote: that is shown by a time impact analysis to delay an activity on the critical path of the most recent accepted schedule update

compensable_causes.quote: CM is entitled to an increase in the General Conditions Costs for an extension of the Contract Time only when the delay was caused by Owner, or by a separate contractor or consultant retained by Owner other than Architect, and the delay affected the critical path.

concurrent_delay.quote: When a delay to the critical path has concurrent causes and one of them is the responsibility of CM or its Subcontractors, CM shall receive an extension of time but no additional compensation for the period of concurrency.

notes.gc_base_fee: fixed $1,214,600 (Section 5.1) is not the change-order Fee

C.name: Contract C (HELD OUT): synthetic GC/CM contract (Middle School HVAC Replacement and Seismic Retrofit)

markup_own_pct.quote: For changed Work performed by a Subcontractor with its own forces, the Subcontractor's overhead and profit shall not exceed twelve percent (12%) of its direct cost; for changed Work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors, the Subcontractor may add six percent (6%) to the lower-tier cost.

markup_lower_pct.quote: For changed Work performed by a Subcontractor with its own forces, the Subcontractor's overhead and profit shall not exceed twelve percent (12%) of its direct cost; for changed Work performed by its lower-tier subcontractors, the Subcontractor may add six percent (6%) to the lower-tier cost.

markup_total_pct.quote: The total of all overhead and profit markups by all tiers on any item of changed Work, excluding the Contractor's Fee, shall not exceed seventeen percent (17%).

fee_pct.quote: Section 9.4.3 is amended by deleting "four percent (4%)" and substituting "three and three-quarters percent (3.75%)".
fee_pct.note: Section 9.4.3 states 4%, but Supplementary Condition 16.3 replaces it with 3.75%; Section 1.2 makes Article 16 govern over the Articles.

fee_allowed_on.quote: The Contractor's Fee on a Change Order shall be four percent (4%) of the sum of the Contractor's direct costs, Subcontractor quotes as marked up under Section 9.4.2, and the premiums for bonds and insurance attributable to the change.
fee_allowed_on.note: The base of the Fee is unchanged by 16.3; only the rate is amended.

labor_burden_pct.quote: plus a labor burden of thirty-five percent (35%) of base wages

blue_book_pct.quote: Equipment owned by the Contractor or an affiliate is charged at eighty percent (80%) of the rates in the current Equipment Watch Rental Rate Blue Book

approval_limit.quote: Change Orders whose individual value does not exceed One Hundred Thousand Dollars ($100,000) may be executed by the District's Capital Projects Director.

notice_days_by_cause.quote: The Contractor shall give the District written notice of a Potential Change within five (5) days after receipt of an RFI response, Architect's supplemental instruction, submittal return, or direction from the District or the Architect, or after first observing a concealed or unknown physical condition at the site, which the Contractor shall not disturb until the District has had an opportunity to observe it. For any other event or circumstance on which the Contractor intends to base a request for additional cost or time, notice shall be given within twenty (20) days after the Contractor knew or should have known of it.

contract_days.quote: The Contractor shall achieve Substantial Completion of the entire Work within four hundred fifty-five (455) calendar days after the date of the Notice to Proceed for Construction.

liquidated_damages_per_day.quote: For each calendar day after the Contract Time that Substantial Completion has not been achieved, the Contractor shall pay the District Two Thousand Two Hundred Dollars ($2,200) as liquidated damages and not as a penalty.

daily_delay_rate.quote: the Specified General Conditions shall be increased by $2,975.00 per calendar day of the extension
daily_delay_rate.note: Repeated in Exhibit B; Section 5.3 governs (Section 1.2: Articles over Exhibits).

sgc_total.quote: The Specified General Conditions are a lump sum of $1,412,750

extension_requires_critical_path.quote: the Contract Time shall be extended by Change Order for such reasonable time as the District's Project Manager may determine.
extension_requires_critical_path.note: not stated. Section 8.3.1 extends time 'for such reasonable time as the District's Project Manager may determine' and Section 8.3.2 asks only for a narrative and 'such schedule information as ... may reasonably require'. Section 3.5 requires the schedule to show the critical path but does not make critical-path delay a condition of an extension. A reader should return null / not found, not true.

compensable_causes.quote: The Contractor shall be compensated for extended Specified General Conditions under Section 5.3 only for a delay caused by the District, by the Architect, or by a concealed physical condition at the site that differs materially from the Contract Documents.
compensable_causes.note: 'District' is the Owner. Weather and other causes beyond both parties' control: time only.

concurrent_delay.quote: Where a delay results from concurrent causes, one attributable to the District and one to the Contractor, the extension shall be granted for the full period of delay, but the compensation for extended Specified General Conditions shall be apportioned between the District and the Contractor in proportion to their respective contributions to the delay.
concurrent_delay.note: Full time extension; extended Specified General Conditions apportioned by each party's share of the delay (not 'time, no money').

notes.extension_requires_critical_path: not stated in contract C (value null); see the term's note
notes.fee_pct: 4% in Section 9.4.3 is superseded by 3.75% in Section 16.3
notes.gc_base_fee: 5.25% of the MACC (Section 5.1) is not the change-order Fee
notes.phase_1_liquidated_damages: $750 per day (Section 3.3) is an interim milestone rate, not the Substantial Completion rate
notes.field_order_limit: $7,500 (Section 9.5) is the site representative's Field Order limit, not the Change Order approval limit
notes.architect_non_compensable: Section 7.2 bars time and money for Architect review of resubmittals the Contractor caused; Architect-caused delay is otherwise compensable under 9.4.7
